text_blocks.snippet: Renal artery stenosis treatment focuses on improving blood flow to the kidneys, primarily through lifestyle changes, medications, and sometimes surgery or angioplasty. Medications like ACE inhibitors or ARBs are often used to control blood pressure and preserve kidney function. If medications are insufficient, angioplasty (with or without a stent) or surgery might be considered to open the narrowed artery.
